description.value: Milk Shed is a neighbourhood coffeehouse tucked into the Mission area of Kelowna, right along the Lakeshore Road corridor that many cyclists use to tour the Okanagan's lake edge. It operates as a compact cafe with outdoor seating, offering a low-key stop to regroup between winery visits or longer rides south of downtown Kelowna.
